description: If you know how to code you can join
summary:
ASTRA MISSION LAB is an interactive educational space mission design and simulation game that allows users to experience the responsibilities of real space mission engineers and scientists.
Instead of simply learning about satellites, spacecraft and space exploration through textbooks, users actively design their own space missions, make engineering decisions, manage limited resources and observe the consequences of their choices.
The main idea is to transform complex space engineering concepts into an engaging, interactive and understandable gaming experience.
One of the biggest challenges in understanding space exploration is that space missions involve multiple interconnected engineering systems.
For example:
Imagine that a scientist wants to study distant galaxies
They might choose an advanced optical telescope. However, this decision affects several other engineering requirements:
- The telescope increases spacecraft mass.
- The instrument requires electrical power.
- It generates scientific data.
- The spacecraft needs communication capabilities to transmit that data.
- The increased complexity affects the mission budget.
This is the central educational concept behind ASTRA.
details:
The project is developed as a web-based application using accessible web technologies.

Software and development tools:

  • Visual Studio Code – Code development and project management.
  • Web browser – Application testing and interaction.
  • Python HTTP Server – Local development and testing.
  • HTML5 – Application structure and content.
  • CSS3 – Galaxy-inspired user interface, styling and responsive layouts.
  • JavaScript – Interactive application logic and user interactions.
  • SVG and image assets – Application icons and visual elements.

NASA and space-agency resources used for research and inspiration:

  • NASA Design and Develop Science Missions.
  • NASA General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT).
  • NASA CubeSat 101.
  • NASA Visualize a Space Mission Using Virtual Reality.
  • Canadian Space Agency Digital Games and Activities.
